content.intro: In this lesson, you will work through working with data-* attributes with a focused jQuery example. The subtopics below preserve the supplied curriculum coverage and connect the API idea to a small browser interface.
content.why_it_matters: This topic is useful because it turns html custom data attributes into a repeatable implementation choice. Attributes describe markup; properties represent current DOM state. For example, checked and selected are runtime properties, while data-* attributes are markup strings and jQuery data values are a separate cache.
